Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies

Entry #
123
Category
Cookies
Class
123 - Chocolate Chip
Servings
24
Prep Time
25 min
Cook Time
12 min

Ingredients

  • 2 cups flour
  • 1 cup browned butter
  • 1 cup brown sugar
  • 2 eggs
  • 2 cups chocolate chips

Method

  1. Brown the butter and cool slightly.
  2. Combine dry ingredients.
  3. Mix butter, sugar, and eggs, then fold in dry ingredients and chocolate.
  4. Portion and bake until the edges are set.

Notes

Cool on the sheet before transferring to a rack.
